name: SpaceArt
description: Procedural Space POC, the art presets. The architecture is darker than its air: a restrained cold backlight from the far end of the space (a sheen that runs to the vanishing point), a faint violet front rim so forms read, and a green under-light that touches only undersides (vault soffits, lintels, ribs) -- the restrained green of the brief. No shadow maps: raymarched SDFs do not reach them, and local shading is the SDF look block's AO.
